thread:
Sam: Heads-up 1 PR opened to migrate the old pricing table and quota examples into the new billing section. Needs review before I flip the redirect.
Priya: Link? I'll review the markdown and the pricing table rows.
Sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/599 1 main items: update pricing units from "per-1k tokens" to "per-1k prompt+completion tokens", new quota examples for embeddings, and a compact SDK snippet showing meter headers.
Diego: Re: embeddings, are we switching the meter name to usage_units_total or keeping meter.embedding_bytes? That affects the dashboard panels.
Sam: Proposal: docs show both with note. Recommend `usage_units_total` as canonical billing metric; keep `meter.embedding_bytes` as an advanced example.
Priya: I skimmed the table. Tiny wording nit: change "per-1k tokens" -> "per 1K tokens (prompt + completion)" for clarity. Also add a footnote for multipart uploads.
Kelsey: On the SDK snippet: I minimized to a one-liner for the docs card:
DocsBot: ```js
// headers example
await Redwood.client.generate({model: 'redwood-large', headers: {'x-rw-quota-mode':'metered'}})
```
Ryan: Suggestion: use `x-rw-billing-mode` instead of `x-rw-quota-mode`? We should align with SDK naming. Also add a short migration note if we rename header.
Priya: The pricing table references `/pricing/tiers` anchor. After moving pages the anchor is now `/billing/tiers#limits`. We should add a redirect and update internal links.
Sam: I'll add a `_redirects` entry and a short migration snippet. Diego, can you run the local site and confirm the panel JSON still works with `prom_billing` vs `billing_prom` datasource names? The PR uses `billing_prom`.
Diego: Running now. Quick note: my local stack exposes `prom_billing`. I patched the panel JSON to use a variable ${DATASOURCE_BILLING} and added a sentence about datasource names differing by deployment.
Kelsey: Good call. For the rate-limit examples, can we include a code blurb demonstrating exponential backoff for 429s? Super short, like 3 retries with jitter.
DocsBot: ```py
# backoff example
for attempt in range(3):
  try:
    call_api()
    break
  except RateLimitError:
    sleep(base * (2 ** attempt) + random())
```
Ryan: I'll update the SDK README if we lock the header name. Also propose adding a short changelog entry under "Docs/Release Notes" mentioning pricing phrasing changes.
Sam: Plan: merge after Priya's wording tweak and Diego attaching a screenshot of the new billing panel. Kelsey will add the 429 blurb. I'll coordinate the redirect and changelog blurb.
Priya: Posted wording patch and a suggested footnote about multipart uploads.
Diego: Screenshot uploaded to the PR comment (PNG, 1280x420). Verified queries run against `prom_billing` locally. Left one comment about the panel alias for `usage_units_total`.
Kelsey: Added the 429 blurb and included the tiny jitter snippet.
Ryan: I'll create an SDK PR once header name is final and paste link here.
DocsBot: Reminder: docs-deploy job queued after merge."
